cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: dependencykfeg 25.0.3, 25.1.3 and 25.1.9 contain no code of their own and declare a single dependency that npm fetches from a tarball in the GitHub repository `GamerD11/ping_test` (`https://github.com/GamerD11/ping_test/raw/refs/heads/main/node-acct-utils-1.0.0.tgz`), whose `preinstall` script runs `node index.js` on install. The first version of the tarball sends the username, hostname, home and working directories, platform, architecture and Node.js version in an HTTP POST to `yrtew6v4g3w9myixyizv5cvfa6gx4zso.oastify.com`; the current version, swapped in on 2026-10-29, reads the collector host from `burp_collaborator.txt` in the same repository, adds the machine's public IP address, network operator and ASN from `ipinfo.io`, and sends everything over HTTPS with certificate verification disabled. The packages have no legitimate functionality, the data is collected without the user's knowledge, and because the install-time code lives outside the registry on a mutable branch, the publisher can replace it with a harmful payload at any time without a new npm release. Any machine that installed one of these versions has disclosed its identity and network location to a third party; the other published versions are not part of this report.

files.note: second stage v1 (GamerD11/ping_test commit aab6519c20): preinstall HTTP POST of user, host and paths to oastify.com
second stage v2 (GamerD11/ping_test commit e74e024638): adds ipinfo.io lookup, HTTPS POST to the host in burp_collaborator.txt
